summary: stui marks explicitly declared standing seats with a dim Nerd Font anchor after their name in both Agents sidebar views, retaining the marker when names are shortened.

replay.detail: Presentation only; no replay or projection rebuild.

schema.detail: Consumes the existing optional client-v0 lifecycle enum; no database or API schema changes.

rules.detail: Only declared standing lifecycle renders a marker. Owner, bounded, and undeclared lifecycles remain unmarked.

compatibility.detail: Older daemons omit lifecycle and render no marker. The anchor is U+F0031 and requires a Nerd Font for its intended appearance.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No declaration changes are required. A terminal Nerd Font displays the anchor.

recovery.detail: No stored state transition or new recovery procedure.
